subject.title: fix: restore Kiro usage refresh across CLI transports

question: Should this PR require a redacted authenticated exact-head Kiro usage refresh, or is the controlled live-process transport matrix sufficient for merge?
rationale: The missing evidence requires access to an approved logged-in Kiro account, which this review cannot safely exercise under repository policy; only a maintainer can waive that end-to-end proof requirement.

options.title: Require authenticated refresh proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a redacted packaged-helper run shows three successful refresh timings, parsed quota/context presence, and no remaining Kiro process.

options.title: Waive account-dependent proof
options.body: Accept the exact-head pipe-only and terminal-required process matrix after all hosted checks pass, despite the absence of authenticated quota output.

recommendation.title: Require authenticated refresh proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until a redacted packaged-helper run shows three successful refresh timings, parsed quota/context presence, and no remaining Kiro process.
